build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates a physics puzzle scene with ramps and teeter-totters
create_cos_helper: create a helper function that computes the cosine of an angle given in degrees
add_static_bar: create a static bar object in the PHYRE scene with a specified angle and scale
add_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object in the PHYRE scene at a given position
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task to define a touching spatial relationship between two bodies
